facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.apply_gumbel_softmax: sample from logits using the Gumbel-Softmax trick with configurable temperature and hard sampling
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.quantize_tensor_with_straight_through: quantize a tensor to discrete levels using straight-through estimator for gradient flow
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.categorical_discretization_with_gumbel: discretize categorical probabilities into continuous values using Gumbel sampling and linspace steps

facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.build_film_layer: build a FiLMLayer that applies feature-wise linear modulation using scale and shift on input features
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.build_variational_layer: build a VariationalLayer that samples latent vectors with KL divergence loss for VAE models
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.build_quantization_layer: build a QuantizationLayer with vector codebook quantization using L2 or cosine distance and dead point reinitialization
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.build_linear_experts_layer: build a LinearExpertsLayer with multiple expert networks and optional softmax gating weights for MoE architectures

facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.create_PCA2D_plot: create a 2D PCA scatter plot from batched tensor values on a matplotlib axis
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.create_PCA2DSequence_plot: create a 2D PCA sequence plot showing temporal trajectories from batched tensor data
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.create_PlotFunctions_chart: create a line chart plotting multiple function values with optional step and y-axis limits
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.create_PlotGridMap_image: create a grid map image visualization using imshow with a bone colormap on an axis
facebookresearch_ai4animationpy/ai4anima.create_LossHistory_tracker: create a LossHistory tracker to log, plot, and display cumulative training loss over time
